title: One Beam at the LHC Carries Enough Energy to Melt Half a Ton of Copper

scenes.text: One beam at the Large Hadron Collider could melt half a ton of copper.
Each beam is made of 2,808 bunches of protons.
They travel almost as fast as light, around a 27 kilometer ring.
At full power, one beam stores 362 million joules.
That is enough to melt about 500 kilograms of copper.
Both beams together could melt nearly one ton.

description:
